notes: $YOLO of moneycanbuy.fun, the second of four launches (support), paired with IMD on Ethereum mainnet; script/LaunchPlan.sol is the plan in code. YoloToken (src/token/YoloToken.sol): name YOLO, symbol YOLO, 18 decimals, 1,000,000,000 YOLO minted once to msg.sender, the factory; no owner, no mint, burn or pause, no editable list. Constructor: the Uniswap v4 PoolManager ($poolManager), the NftGate of launch #2292 (0x97c8fe82527f1a65a147bb0b425c717e4ec547c2), the project wallet that receives the tax (0x3c587eff6c96eacf7e3dcc2cff6416161386e48c), and openAt 1792594800 (21 Oct 2026 15:00 UTC; the constructor requires deployment <= openAt <= deployment + 30 days, else BadOpenAt, and the token is the first creation of launchCustom, so a launch mined after openAt fails whole). The owner's first choice was 1792584000 (12:00 UTC); this manifest applies the brief's one exception, its maximum, because a block before 12:00 UTC cannot be assured: at this revision the chain stood at 1792549019 (02:17 UTC), review had reopened the manifest twice on this deadline, and verification, review, attestation, admission and deployment remained. 12:00 deploys in no block after it; 15:00 in every block up to 15:00 UTC. The NftGate must be sealed before this openAt (sealedAt() was 0 at 02:17 UTC). A buy is a transfer out of the PoolManager, a sell a transfer into it; the factory (seeding, claimFees, the swarm's share) and the PoolManager are exempt, and wallet transfers are never taxed. Before openAt every buy reverts TradingNotOpen(openAt); seeding and sells pass untaxed. Minutes 0-30 after openAt: only wallets in the gate's sealed snapshot may buy (SnapshotNotSealed unless sealedAt() < openAt; consume(buyer, amount) enforces 500,000 YOLO per NFT; no code at the gate means no whitelist), buys untaxed, every sell pays 30% in YOLO to the project wallet. Minutes 30-60: anyone trades, the tax on both sides falls linearly from 30% to 0 (amount x 3000 x (3600 - elapsed) / 18,000,000, rounded down); a buy tax comes out of what the pool sends, a sell tax on top from the seller, so the pool gets exactly the settled amount. From minute 60 a plain ERC-20 for good. Accepted limits: ERC-6909 claims kept in the PoolManager skip openAt, the gate and the tax until taken out; wallet liquidity added after openAt pays the sell tax; pools outside Uniswap v4 are untaxed; in minutes 0-30 routes paying a router first are refused. Economics: 15% of the supply seeds the YOLO/IMD pool at a 15,000 IMD opening cap, the remainder goes to the YoloSplitter of launch #2292 (economics.remainderTo); the swarm's 10% is the factory's. Support contracts, none holds user funds, constructors take only addresses and integers: DevPrices (owner the dev wallet 0x8ad18e99f4c8d8406f9ba8899cf308000518a981) holds the hand-set USD prices of YOLO (start 0.001), ETH (2,400) and IMD (5.5), USDC fixed at 1; zero refused, at most 10x per call; prices only size the doer stake bonus; its owner alone may cancel a task (refunds only) and set the buyback wallet. UniswapV3SwapAdapter swaps ETH or USDC to IMD through SwapRouter02 for bonds paid in those. ParamsRegistry (owner the project wallet) holds version 1 parameters and the swarm answer signers, changed only behind a 48-hour timelock inside compiled bounds, and can pause new tasks; it never moves money. TextRules, SwarmQuestionBuilder and AttestationChecker are stateless helpers. VotePower says who may vote with an identity.md NFT (owner or delegate.xyz v2 delegate); no state or owner. BuybackBurner swaps nothing: anyone may burnYolo() what sits there to 0x...dEaD and forward ETH, USDC and IMD to the buyback wallet, initially 0x027e55f01e8cf808e5d2a2ad68e5e7f67fd6df6e. The core (YoloLockHub, CaseDesk, DisputeDesk, TaskVault) follows as an evm_contracts launch taking this launch's addresses as static arguments, then the $YOLO modules. pool.initialPrice is provenance only: the deployer derives the price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply.
